TableCategory.description: Supported table types include ALL (all tables), WITH_UNIQUE_ROW_ID (tables with a unique row identity), and WITHOUT_UNIQUE_ROW_ID (tables without a unique row identity). The default value is ALL.

ActiveActive.description: Indicates whether this is an active-active disaster recovery scenario.

MqSerializerType.description: The JSON serialization type for data delivered to the message queue. Valid values include DEFAULT, CANAL, DATAWORKS_V2, SHAREPLEX, DEFAULT_WITH_SCHEMA, DEBEZIUM, DEBEZIUMFlatten, and DEBEZIUMSMT.

MqPartitionMode.description: The partition routing method when delivering messages to the message queue. Valid values include ONE (delivery to a specified partition), HASH (delivery based on hash of the primary key or shard column value), and TABLE (delivery based on hash of the database and table name).

MqPartition.description: When `MqPartitionMode` is `ONE`, this parameter specifies the position of the delivery partition under the current topic.

DatahubTopicType.description: When delivering messages to the DataHub message queue, specify the topic type. Valid enumeration values are `BLOB` and `TUPLE`.

RocketMqProducerGroup.description: Specifies the producer group name (effective only when the target is ROCKETMQ). The default value is OMS.

RocketMqMsgTags.description: Set the message tag (takes effect only when the target is ROCKETMQ). The default value is default->default_tag.

RocketMqEnableMsgTrace.description: Whether to enable message tracing (effective only when the target is ROCKETMQ).

RocketMqSendMsgTimeout.description: Set the message delivery timeout (takes effect only when the target is ROCKETMQ).

DataWorksBusinessName.description: Operational System identity. This parameter identifies the source operational system of the data, enabling subsequent custom processing. You can set this parameter only when the serialization method is DataWorks. The length must be 1 to 20 characters.

SyncSchema.description: Specifies whether to synchronize the schema of the source data to the target. If enabled, an additional column is expected to be created on the target table to receive the schema name. The name of this column is specified by the `syncSchemaColumnName` parameter.
SyncSchema.title: Whether to Synchronize the Schema of the Source Data to the Target (an Additional Column Is Expected on the Target Table to Receive the Schema Name; See the syncSchemaColumnName Parameter)

SyncSchemaColumnName.description: If the feature to synchronize the schema to the target is enabled, you can specify the column name to be synchronized to the target (the column must be pre-created on the target).
SyncSchemaColumnName.title: If the feature to synchronize the schema to the target is enabled, you can specify the field name to be synchronized to the target.

CustomColumns.description: An array of custom columns. The corresponding columns must be pre-created on the target side.

Expression.description: The expression for the column value.
Expression.title: Column Value Expression

SinkStoreFormat.description:
The storage class of the target table object. This parameter takes effect only when the target OceanBase database is version V4.3.0 or later, and either **Schema Migration** or **Incremental Synchronization** > **DDL Synchronization** is selected on the **Select Migration Type** page.

The available storage classes for the target table object include **default** (DEFAULT), **row store** (ROW), **column store** (COLUMN), and **hybrid row-column store** (COMPOUND). This parameter determines the storage class of the target table object during schema migration or incremental synchronization. For more information, see [default_table_store_format](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000002015561).

> The **default** option automatically adapts to other options based on the target-side configuration. Specifically, table objects created during schema migration or new table objects from incremental DDL operations are written with the structure corresponding to the configured storage class.
SinkStoreFormat.title: If the feature of synchronizing schema to the target is enabled, you can specify the field name for synchronization to the target

SourceStoreFormat.description:
The storage class of the source table object. This parameter takes effect when the source OceanBase database is version V4.3.0 or later, and **Reverse Incremental** > **DDL Synchronization** is selected on the **Select Migration Type** page.

The storage classes for the source table object include **default** (DEFAULT), **row store** (ROW), **column store** (COLUMN), and **compound store** (COMPOUND). This parameter determines the storage class of the source table object during reverse incremental synchronization. For more information, see [default_table_store_format](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000002015561).

> The **default** option automatically adapts to other options based on the target-side parameter configuration. When reverse incremental synchronization is enabled, newly created table objects from incremental DDL are written to the corresponding structure according to the configured storage class.
SourceStoreFormat.title: If the feature to synchronize the schema to the target is enabled, you can specify the field name to be synchronized to the target.

schema.description: Specifies whether to allow structure transfer.
Configuration for structure transfer.

ByteCharConvertStrategy.description: The byte/char conversion strategy. Enumeration values include `IGNORE_BYTE_IF_BYTE_USED`, `FORCE_CHAR_IF_BYTE_USED`, `EXPAND_LEN_IF_BYTE_USED`, and `DO_NOTHING_IF_BYTE_USED` (default value).

DeferIndexCreation.description: Whether to allow deferred index creation.

schema.description: Specifies whether to enable full data transfer.
Specifies whether to enable full verification.
Configuration for full data transfer.

NonePkUkTruncateDstTable.description:
Specifies whether to delete data from the target table when performing full migration for tables without a unique index on the source.  
Scenario: Multiple links from a PolarDB-X 1.0 database with tables lacking primary keys converge into the same target table. This avoids a situation where partial data from earlier links is erased by another link that truncates the target table immediately upon starting.

AllowDestTableNotEmpty.description:
The policy for handling cases where the target table object contains records. Options include **Ignore** and **Stop Migration**.  
- When set to true, it selects "Ignore": If the target table object contains data and there is a conflict between the existing data and the incoming data, Data Transmission Service logs the conflicting data and retains the original data unchanged during data ingestion.  
><notice>If "Ignore" is selected, full validation uses the IN pattern to pull data, which cannot validate scenarios where extra data exists on the target side, and validation performance is degraded to some extent.></notice>  
- When set to false, it selects "Stop Migration": If the target table object contains data, full migration reports an error and does not allow migration. You must clean up the data on the target side before proceeding with migration.  
><notice>If you click recover after an error occurs, Data Transmission Service ignores this configuration option and continues migrating table data. Proceed with caution.></notice>

FullTransferSpeedMode.description:
The concurrent speed for full migration, including STEADY, NORMAL, and FAST.  
><notice>If a full migration step exists, FullTransferSpeedMode must be specified; you can specify NORMAL.</notice>

FullVerifySpeedMode.description:
The concurrent speed for full validation, including STEADY, NORMAL, and FAST.  
><notice>If a full validation step exists, FullVerifySpeedMode must be specified; you can specify NORMAL.</notice>

State.description:
The status of the cluster. Valid values:   
- ONLINE: The cluster is running.  
- PENDING_CREATE: The cluster is being created.  
- ARREARS_CLOSED("arrears_closed"): The cluster is suspended due to insufficient balance.
- PREPAID_EXPIRE_CLOSED("prepaid_expire_closed"): The cluster is suspended because the subscription has expired.
- WHITE_LIST_MODIFYING("white_list_modifying"): The allowlist of the cluster is being modified.
- SSL_MODIFYING("ssl_modifying"): The Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) settings of the cluster are being modified.
- PARAMETER_MODIFYING("parameter_modifying"): Parameters of the cluster are being modified.
- TENANT_CREATING("tenant_creating"): A tenant is being created in the cluster.
- TENANT_SPEC_MODIFYING("tenant_spec_modifying"): The specifications of a tenant in the cluster are being modified.
- EXPANDING("expanding"): Nodes are being added to the cluster.
- REDUCING("reducing"): Nodes are being removed from the cluster.
- ZONE_CHANGING("zone_changing"): Zones of the cluster are being modified.
- SPEC_UPGRADING: The service plan is being upgraded.
- SPEC_DOWNGRADING("spec_downgrading"): The plan specification is being downgraded.
- DISK_UPGRADING: The storage space is being expanded.
- UPGRADING("upgrading"): The version of the cluster is being upgraded.
- PENDING_DELETE("pending_delete"): The cluster is being deleted.
- DELETED("deleted"): The cluster has been deleted.
- ABNORMAL("abnormal"): The cluster is abnormal.
- OFFLINE("offline"): The cluster is offline.
- STANDBY_CREATING("standby_creating"): A standby cluster is being created for the cluster.
- STANDBY_DELETING("standby_deleting"): A standby cluster of the cluster is being deleted.
- SWITCHOVER_SWITCHING("switchover_switching"): The cluster is undergoing a primary/standby switchover.
- STANDBY_DISCONNECTING("standby_disconnecting"): The cluster is being decoupled from its standby cluster.
- LOG_DISK_UPGRADING("log_disk_upgrading"): The log disk of the cluster is being scaled out.
- ISOLATION_OPTIMIZATION_MODIFYING("isolation_optimization_modifying"): The isolation optimization settings of the cluster are being modified.
- DISKTYPE_MODIFYING("disktype_modifying"): The data disk type of the cluster is being modified.
- PROXY_SERVICE_CREATING("proxy_service_creating"): The proxy service is being enabled for the cluster.
- PROXY_SERVICE_DELETING("proxy_service_deleting"): The proxy service is being disabled for the cluster.
- PROXY_SERVICE_SPEC_MODIFYING("proxy_service_spec_modifying"): The proxy service specification is being modified for the cluster.
- READONLY_ADD_NODE("readonly_add_node"): A read-only node is being added to the cluster.
- READONLY_REDUCE_NODE("readonly_reduce_node"): A read-only node is being removed from the cluster.
- READONLY_REDUCE_ZONE("readonly_reduce_zone"): A read-only zone is being removed from the cluster.
- READONLY_ADD_ZONE("readonly_add_zone"): A read-only zone is being added to the cluster.
- READONLY_UPGRADE_SPEC("readonly_upgrade_spec"): The specification of read-only replicas is being upgraded.
- READONLY_UPGRADE_DISK("readonly_upgrade_disk"): The disk space of read-only replicas is being scaled out.
- READONLY_DOWNGRADE_SPEC("readonly_downgrade_spec"): The specification of read-only replicas is being downgraded.
- READONLY_DOWNGRADE_DISK("readonly_downgrade_disk"): The disk space of read-only replicas is being scaled in.
- CREATING_TENANT_READONLY_REPLICA("creating_tenant_readonly_replica"): A read-only replica is being created for a tenant in the cluster.

The type of the replica. Node filtering conditions are configured based on the replica type when you query the monitoring data of the OceanBase cluster. 
* By default, the replica type is not specified when you query the monitoring data of OceanBase clusters or the access proxy. If you do not specify the replica type when you query the monitoring data of an OceanBase cluster, the monitoring data of all nodes is queried. 
* If you set the replica type to FULL when you query the monitoring data of an OceanBase cluster, the monitoring data of only the full-featured replica nodes is queried.

AllowDestTableNotEmpty.description:
The policy for handling cases where the target table object contains records, including **Ignore** and **Stop Migration**.  
- When set to true, it selects "Ignore": If data already exists in the target table object and conflicts occur between existing data and incoming data, Data Transmission Service logs the conflicting records and retains the original data unchanged during data ingestion.  
><notice>When "Ignore" is selected, full validation uses the IN pattern to pull data, which cannot validate scenarios where extra data exists on the target side, and validation performance is degraded to some extent.></notice>  
- When set to false, it selects "Stop Migration": If data already exists in the target table object, full migration reports an error and does not proceed. You must handle the data on the target side before continuing migration.  
><notice>If you click recover after an error occurs, Data Transmission Service ignores this configuration option and continues migrating table data. Proceed with caution.></notice>

## StepInfo Data Structure

The `StepInfo` parameters for different steps return different fields.

* TRANSFER_APP_SWITCH (forward switchover)

     | Parameter | Type | Description |
     |----------|----------------|---------------|
     | checkpointSampleTimestamp | long | Offset collection time. The format is a Unix timestamp, in seconds. |

* INCR_TRANSFER (incremental synchronization)

   | Parameter | Type | Description |
   |----------|----------------|---------------|
   | incrTimestampCheckpoint | long | Offset timestamp. The format is a Unix timestamp, in seconds. |
   | checkpointSampleTimestamp | long | Offset collection time. The format is a Unix timestamp, in seconds. |
   | enableIncrStatistics | boolean | Indicates whether DML/DDL statistics are enabled. |

* FULL_VERIFIER (full validation) and FULL_TRANSFER (full migration)

     | Parameter | Type | Description |
     |------------|------------------|------------------------|
     | processedRecords | long | Number of migrated records or actual records processed. |
     | capacity | long | Estimated total number of records. |
     | srcRps | long | Source read RPS, in records per second. |
     | srcRt | string | Source read response time (RT), in milliseconds per record. |
     | srcIops | long | Source read traffic, in bytes per second. |
     | dstRps | long | Target read/write RPS, in records per second. |
     | dstRt | long | Target read/write response time (RT), in milliseconds per record. |
     | dstIops | long | Target read/write traffic, in bytes per second. |
     | srcRpsRef | long | Baseline value for source read RPS. |
     | dstRpsRef | long | Baseline value for target read/write RPS. |
     | dstRtRef | long | Baseline value for target read/write response time (RT). |

schema.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task.
Name of the task step. Valid values: `FULL_TRANSFER`, `INCR_TRANSFER`, `FULL_VERIFIER`, and `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER`.

Metrics corresponding to the task execution steps.
  • `FULL_TRANSFER` includes the following metrics: RPS, IOPS, SOURCE_READ_TIME, SOURCE_SLICE_TIME, and SINK_EXECUTE_TIME.
  • `INCR_TRANSFER` includes the following metrics: DELAY, IOPS, RPS, SINK_COMMIT_TIME, and SINK_EXECUTE_TIME.
  • `FULL_VERIFIER` includes the following metrics: FULL_VERIFY_SOURCE_RPS, FULL_VERIFY_SOURCE_READ_IOPS, FULL_VERIFY_DEST_RPS, and FULL_VERIFY_DEST_READ_IOPS.
  • `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER` includes the following metrics: RPS, IOPS, DELAY, SINK_EXECUTE_TIME, and SINK_COMMIT_TIME.
Aggregation operator. Valid values: `AVG` (average data line chart) and `NONE` (instantaneous data line chart). Default value: `NONE`.
Start time, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The interval between the start time and end time must be at least 1 hour.
End time, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The end time cannot be later than the current time.
Maximum number of query points. Valid range: 5 to 7 × 24 × 60. Recommended setting: time interval (in minutes) / maxPointNum > 5.

ListDataSource.responseParamsDescription:
## Appendix
### Kafka

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "endpoint":"xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883",
        "username":null,
        "enableSSL":null,
        "enableSASL":null,
        "saslMechanism":null,
        "disableIdentificationAlgorithm":false
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| endpoint     |      string     | The service endpoint.            |
|  username    |   string        | The username. This parameter is required when you select PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256, or SCRAM-SHA-512 as the authentication type.          |
|  enableSSL    |   boolean        | Indicates whether SSL authentication is enabled. If enabled, you must upload a trusted certificate.         |
|  enableSASL    |    boolean       | Indicates whether SASL authentication is enabled.         |
| saslMechanism     |KafkaSaslMechanisnEnum         |   The encryption method, which includes PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-512, and KERBEROS.         |
|disableIdentificationAlgorithm |  boolean  |Indicates whether hostname verification is enabled during SSL encryption. |

### DataHub

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "endpoint":"xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883",
        "project":"detx***"
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| endpoint     |      string     | The service endpoint.            |
|  project    |   string        | The name of the job.          |

### RocketMQ

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "endpoint":"xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883",
        "endpointType":null,
        "version":null
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| endpoint     |      string     | The service endpoint.            |
|  endpointType    |   CloudRocketMQEndpoint.Type        | The type of the service endpoint.          |
| version | CloudRocketMQInst.Version  | The version of RocketMQ.|

### OceanBase

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "cluster":"xgez***",
        "tenant":"gexr**",
        "isLogicSource":false,
        "useLogProxy":true,
        "drcUser":"tes***",
        "configUrl":"http://xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883/service****",
        "logProxyIp":"xxx.xxx.xxx.2",
        "logProxyPort":2883,
        "noUserAuth":false
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| cluster     |      string     | The name of the cluster.            |
|  tenant    |   string        | The name of the tenant.          |
| isLogicSource | boolean | Indicates whether the data source is logical.|
| useLogProxy | boolean  | Indicates whether LogProxy is used.|
| drcUser  |  string | The configuration of drc_user.  |
| configUrl  |  string |  Used to obtain the real addresses of the underlying OceanBase database servers. |
| logProxyIp  | string  | The IP address of the LogProxy service.  |
| logProxyPort  | integer  | The port of the LogProxy service.  |
| noUserAuth  | boolean  | For DataWorks synchronization APIs, the data source is automatically generated by OMS. If no user account and password are provided, you cannot connect to the user's OceanBase database.  |

### TiDB

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "kafkaId":"e_edz****",
        "kafkaTopic":"test**",
        "kafkaName":"denz***"
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| kafkaId     |      string     | The ID of the attached Kafka data source.            |
|  kafkaTopic    |   string        | The name of the attached Kafka topic.           |
| kafkaName | string  | The name of the attached Kafka data source.|

The policy for handling cases where the target table object contains records. Options include **Ignore** and **Stop Migration**.  
- If set to true, it selects "Ignore": When the target table object contains data and conflicts occur between existing data and incoming data, Data Transmission Service logs the conflicting data and retains the original data unchanged during data ingestion.  
><notice>If "Ignore" is selected, full validation uses the IN pattern to pull data, which cannot validate scenarios where extra data exists in the target, and validation performance is degraded to some extent.></notice>  
- If set to false, it selects "Stop Migration": When the target table object contains data, full migration reports an error and does not allow migration. You must handle the data in the target before proceeding with migration.  
><notice>If you click recover after an error occurs, Data Transmission Service ignores this configuration option and continues migrating table data. Proceed with caution.></notice>

## Appendix

### Kafka

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "endpoint":"xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883",
        "username":null,
        "enableSSL":null,
        "enableSASL":null,
        "saslMechanism":null,
        "disableIdentificationAlgorithm":false
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| endpoint     |      string     | The service endpoint.            |
|  username    |   string        | The username. This parameter is required when you select PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256, or SCRAM-SHA-512 as the authentication type.          |
|  enableSSL    |   boolean        | Indicates whether SSL authentication is enabled. If enabled, you must upload a trusted certificate.         |
|  enableSASL    |    boolean       | Indicates whether SASL authentication is enabled.         |
| saslMechanism     |KafkaSaslMechanisnEnum         | The encryption method, which includes PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-512, and KERBEROS.         |
|disableIdentificationAlgorithm |  boolean  | Indicates whether hostname verification is enabled during SSL encryption. |

### DataHub

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "endpoint":"xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883",
        "project":"detx***"
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| endpoint     |      string     | The service endpoint.            |
|  project    |   string        | The name of the job.          |

### RocketMQ

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "endpoint":"xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883",
        "endpointType":null,
        "version":null
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| endpoint     |      string     | The service endpoint.            |
|  endpointType    |   CloudRocketMQEndpoint.Type        | The type of the service endpoint.          |
| version | CloudRocketMQInst.Version  | The version of RocketMQ.|

### OceanBase

```JSON
{
    "connExtraAttributes":{
        "cluster":"xgez***",
        "tenant":"gexr**",
        "isLogicSource":false,
        "useLogProxy":true,
        "drcUser":"tes***",
        "configUrl":"http://xxx.xxx.xxx.1:2883/service****",
        "logProxyIp":"xxx.xxx.xxx.2",
        "logProxyPort":2883,
        "noUserAuth":false
    }
}
```

|          Parameter           |     Type    |      Description          |
|--------------------------|-------------|------------------|
| cluster     |      string     | The name of the cluster.            |
|  tenant    |   string        | The name of the tenant.          |
| isLogicSource | boolean | Indicates whether the data source is logical.|
| useLogProxy | boolean  | Indicates whether LogProxy is used.|
| drcUser  |  string | The configuration of drc_user.  |
| configUrl  |  string | Used to obtain the real addresses of the underlying OceanBase database servers. |
| logProxyIp  | string  | The IP address of the LogProxy service.  |
